title: Desk Rule — Renewal Windows, Non-Renewal Notices and Early Cancellation of the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Desk Rule — Renewal Windows, Non-Renewal Notices and Early Cancellation of the Building Automation Service Plans

**Renewal window.** The renewal window of a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans opens the tier's renewal period before the term end date, and the renewal quote carries the escalated fee and the trued-up point count.

**Automatic renewal.** Where the tier renews automatically the plan renews at the term end unless a non-renewal notice was received by the tier's notice deadline, counted back in calendar days from the term end date with the deadline day counting as timely; the top tier does not renew automatically and ends unless a renewal acceptance is on file for this plan. That acceptance is evidenced by the office's own request records matched to the plan — the request filed against that plan, its type and its recorded outcome — and not by what the caller says was agreed.

**Early cancellation.** A customer may cancel early on the tier's written notice period, and the tier's early cancellation rate is applied to the unbilled remainder of the term. The notice period is counted in calendar days from the day the written notice was received, the notice day excluded and the final day included; the day of receipt is read from the office's request records for that plan. Cancellation stops monitoring on the effective day, and the owner is told plainly that alarms will then reach nobody.

**Expiry.** A plan that simply expires carries no cancellation fee, and the site's controls database backup is retained for the tier's retention period after the plan ends.

The renewal window days, the non-renewal notice days, the escalation, the cancellation notice days and the early cancellation rate per tier are those of the tier terms on renewal and cancellation.

## Points of judgement

| Case | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Automatic-renewal tier, no non-renewal notice by the deadline | the plan renews at term end |
| Automatic-renewal tier, notice received on the deadline day | timely; the plan does not renew |
| Automatic-renewal tier, notice received the day after the deadline | not timely; the plan renews |
| Top tier, renewal acceptance on file for this plan | the plan renews |
| Top tier, no renewal acceptance on file | the plan ends at term end |
| Plan expires at term end | no cancellation fee |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Under a 60-day cancellation notice period, written notice received on the 10th of January makes the 11th of January day one and the 11th of March day sixty, the final day of the period. Under an early cancellation rate of 40 percent, an unbilled remainder of 5000 USD carries an early cancellation fee of 2000 USD.
